title: You can now mod Claude Code like a video game

slides.headline: You can now *mod* Claude Code like a video game.
slides.alt: Cover: You can now mod Claude Code like a video game. There's a catch. A terminal installing a mod with a 'Mod loaded' sticker.

slides.headline: Your coding session can have a *health bar.*
slides.body: One popular mod turns your usage into health and your context window into XP.
slides.alt: A game HUD: usage shown as pixel hearts, the context window as an XP bar.

slides.headline: A mod runs *inside* Claude Code.
slides.body: Hooks only watch. Mods can change what happens next.
slides.alt: Diagram: a tool call goes through your mod, which can run it, rewrite it or skip it.

slides.headline: Pick your *loadout.*
slides.alt: A game inventory with four mod slots: redraw the interface, pause rm -rf and force push (equipped), add your own command, play Doom while it works.

slides.headline: Mods aren't sandboxed. *Check first.*

lines.t: # and every API call it makes

slides.body: They run with your permissions. Only install from sources you trust.
slides.alt: Terminal: claude plugin validate, which lists every event a mod hooks and every API call it makes.

slides.headline: Send this to your team's *first modder.*

visual.title: Before you install
rows: Installed only from a source you trust
Ran claude plugin validate and read it
blast-radius on to pause risky commands

slides.alt: A pre-install checklist: installed only from a source you trust, ran claude plugin validate and read it, blast-radius on to pause risky commands. Send this to your team's first modder.
